notes: UCIe characterization centers on the source-synchronous single-ended channel (very short on-package reach), the always-on sideband, and the D2D Adapter's Flit/CRC/Retry. Conformance is established by the UCIe Compliance Program (electrical, logical, protocol, software). Per-implementation PHY calibration (impedance, forwarded-clock phase, per-lane de-skew, lane repair) is done at bring-up.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Per-lane data eye at the target rate
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify single-ended NRZ data lanes meet the eye/timing budget against the forwarded clock at 4-32 GT/s (e.g. 31.25 ps UI at 32 GT/s).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Forwarded-clock / Track alignment
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the source-synchronous strobe and per-module track/calibration lane keep the receiver sampling point aligned.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Sideband bring-up
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate the always-on 800 MHz sideband (2 lanes/direction) trains and carries management/register traffic before the mainband.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Flit CRC / Retry
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject errors and confirm the 16-bit Flit CRC detects them and Retry replays correctly.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Lane repair / reversal
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify spare-lane remap (Advanced) or width degradation (Standard) and transmit-side lane reversal.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Bandwidth / shoreline density
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure BW/module/dir (64 GB/s Std, 256 GB/s Adv) and shoreline density vs bump pitch.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Latency budget
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm Tx+Rx end-to-end latency < 2 ns (FDI to bump and back).
